a2.decision: Do not select repair of this observed A2 object-coordinate cost as the paper main line on current evidence. Retain as a bounded mechanism diagnostic.

evidence.observed_object_cost: Established in EXACT object coordinates, not all object dimensions or conditions. CHANGE coordinate error improves; NEWPATH and combined RET net-coordinate intervals cross zero.
evidence.signal_noise: EXACT coordinate signal cost 0.010935638 exceeds realized-noise saving 0.004822307; cross cost 0.000780184. Not noise amplification.
evidence.key_context: EXACT repeats same C/O/key/gate to floating precision. Same-key pre-injection coordinate target changes are not larger than grid changes in observed pairs. Key insufficiency exists but object-specific stronger confusion is not established.
evidence.shared_beta: Analytic expected-loss gradients conflict on 1589 of 3113 EXACT writes affecting both grid and coordinates. Both groups still have a common improving first-order output-space direction when summed over writes; no proof of a fundamental shared-scalar capacity limit.
evidence.weighting: Loss averages observed coordinates jointly; EXACT grid weight .778094 and coordinate weight .033267. This allows a rare-coordinate cost to be outweighed by grid benefit, but does not isolate training weights versus gate sharing or contextual mismatch.

recovering_only_observed_exact_coordinat.counterfactual: Assumes all other existing errors unchanged. This is bookkeeping, not a tested policy, not an attainable guarantee and not an upper bound on all possible improvements.

scope.analysis: Existing original A1/A2 linear accounting, descriptive same-key statistics, analytic sensitivity at frozen A2 outputs. Only synthetic derivatives were numerically perturbed for validation.

limits: Only reused dev trajectories at noise .5/ns0; no confirmatory scientific gate passed by this analysis.
Pre-injection C is a standardized slow-model residual, not physical noise-free truth.
Exact actions, continuous pose and Z bodies are absent, so input-channel causal attribution is unavailable.
Retrospective beta sensitivities use future POST losses, not online causal information; opposite signs do not provide a finite attainable gain.
Per-group comparisons are exploratory; different masks/gaps and adjacent A/B source dependence limit interpretation.
The signal-known .5 floor is an informational oracle, not evidence that beta or key changes can realize its headroom.
